script.title: Why Quick Commerce Apps Sell Books Now #shorts

segments.text: Why is Blinkit delivering books and slippers in ten minutes?
Delivering a fifty rupee milk packet earns apps barely two rupees.
segments.broll: hand holding milk packet close up

segments.text: That does not even cover the delivery rider's fuel paisa.
segments.broll: gas station fuel pump nozzle filling

segments.text: So quick commerce platforms are adding books, electronics, and footwear.
segments.broll: person turning book pages close up

segments.text: These categories bring up to thirty percent margins instead of five percent.
It turns a tiny two hundred rupee order into an eight hundred rupee checkout.
And that high margin strategy is the main reason...

script.loop_line: And that high margin strategy is the main reason...
script.description: Ever wondered why Blinkit and Instamart sell books and footwear along with milk? Here is the economics behind quick commerce moving beyond groceries. #PaisaDecoded #QuickCommerce #BusinessStrategy

facts_to_verify.claim: Blinkit and quick commerce platforms entered book retail delivering books in 10 minutes.
Grocery deliver margins are 3-5% while lifestyle and book categories offer 20-30% margins.

script.chosen_candidate: Sonia Gandhi Memoir on Blinkit: Quick-Commerce Enters Book Retail - Rediff MoneyWiz
script.why_it_will_work: It directly explains a weird consumer trend everyone is noticing in India right now using simple order economics and margins.
